The operational process described for Fashion Forward relies on an outdated first-in-first-out (FIFO) storage system. The primary bottleneck identified is the physical arrangement of inventory, where newer stock is placed behind older items. This configuration creates a significant efficiency issue: accessing newer inventory requires time-consuming reorganization efforts to move the older stock. To improve efficiency, the warehouse should consider implementing a system that allows for easier access to specific items regardless of their entry date, such as a slot-based storage system or a warehouse management system that tracks item location dynamically, thereby eliminating the need for manual reorganization to retrieve newer goods.
